artworks.title: Le Perroquet
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene in a barbershop. The image shows a chair with a hat, a seated figure draped in a barber's cape, patterned wallpaper, a framed picture on the wall, an oval mirror, and jars and containers on a surface. The drawing uses light, shadow, and detailing to depict the historic barbershop scene vividly.

artworks.title: Le Charbonnier aime être (est maitre)...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures at a bar or counter. One figure is in a hat holding a drink, while another figure, facing away, is drinking from a glass. The setting is indoors, likely in a café or bar, with a counter or bar behind which bottles and a pitcher are visible. The drawing captures a moment of interaction.

artworks.title: Eh!... Eh!... mais il parait que...
artworks.description: The image depicts a man bending over and holding a weight-lifting contraption with his right hand. He is hunched over, with his head turned to the left. The man has short hair and appears focused on the task. He wears a dark jacket and light-colored pants, revealing his undergarments. His left shoe is held in place by some straps. To his right, a woman with a shawl over her head looks surprised, while another woman with a headscarf watches from behind a small raised platform. To his left, a young boy stands barefoot, with hands in his pockets and wearing loose clothing. In the background, several men in dark coats and top hats are standing and observing the scene. The setting appears to be outdoors, with trees in the background and dappled sunlight or foliage above.

artworks.title: L'Entrée du Grand tunnel d'un chemin de fer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of individuals sitting on a train as it approaches a tunnel. The image depicts a group of four individuals sitting in an open train car as they are about to enter a large and dark tunnel. The person at the front seems to be startled, while the others behind appear slightly anxious. They are dressed in formal attire, complete with top hats. Below them, visible through windows, more individuals are seated, also wearing formal hats and attire. The illustration is titled "L'entrée du grand tunnel d'un chemin de fer". The use of shading and line work effectively conveys the darkness of the tunnel and the contrasting lighter tones highlight the expressions on the passengers' faces. The drawing carries an air of anticipation and humor, capturing the experience of early railway travel.

artworks.title: Une Rencontre en pleine eau
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two boats on the water with several people onboard. The drawing depicts an interaction between two groups of people in different boats, with figures in the foreground and background engaged in conversation while they row. The design is monochromatic, showcasing figures in typical vintage attire, with hats and pipes. The water and shoreline are rendered with simple lines and shading, while the text at the bottom adds dialogue to complement the scene.

artworks.title: Un Homme sauvé malgré lui
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of individuals in a bureaucratic setting. One person is seated at a desk writing, wearing official attire. Another person is leaning over the desk, possibly arguing. Additional individuals are standing and watching, dressed casually. A humorous or satirical exchange about payment for a rescue is depicted at the bottom. The drawing is done in a style with sketch lines and cross-hatching to show expressions on the faces.

artworks.title: L'Élection
artworks.description: Six men are shown from the waist up, standing closely together. One man in the center wears a large top hat and smiles broadly. The other men wear tall, cylindrical hats and dark suits. One man holds a paper. In the background, a man stands at a podium. The setting is an interior space with plain walls. The scene is depicted in a monochrome sketch with line work emphasizing features and expressions.

artworks.title: La Visite électorale
artworks.description: Three people standing in a room. Two on the left facing one on the right. They shake hands. The man in the middle has curly hair and strong facial features, wearing a shirt and pants. The woman next to him has tight curls in her hair and wears a long striped dress. The person on the right has a receding hairline and wears dark clothing. The background shows shelves with drawers and hanging hats, as well as cone-shaped objects.

artworks.title: L'Héritier présomptif
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a comical and slightly absurd domestic scene. A figure is crying, hanging from a hook on the wall, appearing distressed. To the left, there is a partially visible scene with several individuals. Surrounding the central figure are household items such as a cooking pot, a mop, and a plate. The drawing captures elements of mid-19th century daily life with an exaggerated, caricature-like approach.

artworks.title: Premier sujet d'un café-concert chantant...
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman from the waist up, appearing to be speaking or singing and holding a sheet of music or script. She has a loose bun hairstyle, expressive features, and is dressed in a loose-fitting dress. In the background, two other individuals are present, also engaged or observing. The scene is set in a room with multiple chandeliers on the ceiling.

artworks.title: Le Malade imaginaire
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a person facing the viewer with arms crossed over their chest. The individual has distinct facial features including a pronounced nose, deep-set eyes, and a wide-eyed expression. Their hair, visible from beneath a hat, is short and somewhat tousled. They are dressed in a dark, buttoned coat with a high collar. The background enhances the central figure, with text stating "MONOMANES. No. 7" above the portrait and a French description below. The artwork appears to be a lithographic print, as indicated by the signature "h. d" in the lower left.

artworks.title: Le Chasseur Parisien
artworks.description: The image shows a side profile of an older man reading from an open book. He is standing and holding the book in his right hand. The man has distinct facial features, small round glasses, short tousled hair, and is wearing a striped cap with earflaps. He wears a high-collared garment and carries a long firearm under his left arm. In the background, there are sketches of tall grass, marsh reeds, branches, and small birds.

artworks.title: Le Guitariste-Amateur
artworks.description: The image depicts a caricature of a man playing a guitar. The man has expressive facial features, thick curly hair, and is dressed in a dark coat, light waistcoat, high-collared shirt, and a neatly tied cravat. The background has a textured pattern. Text above and below the figure provides details on the subject.

artworks.title: Le Bétophile
artworks.description: The image shows a man in profile facing right. He has exaggerated facial features, a pronounced nose and chin, and short thinning hair. He is wearing a patterned robe and a cap with stripes. He is smiling slightly, holding a small birdcage with a bird inside. The background is plain with light shading. The top portion displays "MONOMANES" and "No. 1", and the bottom part has French text related to the image.

artworks.title: Le Distrait
artworks.description: The upper half of an old man's body is visible in the image. He is standing in front of an easel with a canvas, working on his artwork. The man has distinctive facial features with a prominent nose and cheekbones, wearing small glasses low on his nose. His hair looks sparse and unkempt. He is dressed in a detailed patterned jacket over a dark garment, holding a stick or pointer pointed at the canvas. The background has text in a newspaper or print format, providing texture.

artworks.title: Présentation d'Ulysse a Nausica
artworks.description: This drawing features a group of figures in an outdoor setting. The foreground shows the figures under makeshift tents or large pieces of fabric. The standing figure has ragged clothes, wild hair, and a beard. There is interaction between the figures. The background includes hills and sketched trees, creating a rustic setting.

artworks.title: Les Nuits de Pénélope
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated, leaning back with her head tilted upwards. Her entire body is visible, with her eyes looking towards a faint drawing of a helmeted figure on the wall. She has long hair and is wearing a draped garment. In front of her is a basket with yarn balls, and next to her is a loom with partially woven fabric. The background is a plain wall with a shadow cast from a light source to the upper right.

artworks.title: Henri de Larochejacquelein
artworks.description: The image shows a man depicted in a caricature style. He is standing with an assertive posture, holding a rifle in his right hand that rests on the ground. The man has exaggerated facial features, with a large nose and pronounced chin, and curly hair extending outward. He is dressed in elaborate clothing, including a detailed coat, draped cape, and wide sash around his waist. The background is plain, emphasizing the individual.

artworks.title: On a beau dire, l'antique est toujours beau...
artworks.description: Two individuals are sitting on a bench, observing a marble statue. An elderly woman is on the left, wearing a shawl on her head and shoulders, a long skirt, and a layered top. Beside her sits an older man in a dark coat, high-collared shirt, and a top hat, holding a cane. The man looks at the statue. The statue is in a classic pose on a pedestal. The sketchy background includes trees, indicating an outdoor setting like a park or garden.

artworks.title: Le coton tombe, l'homme reste...
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing and slightly leaning forward. He has a bald head with a fringe of curly hair around the sides and back. His facial features are exaggerated in a caricature style with prominent lines and expressions. He is wearing a loose, long-sleeved shirt that falls to his thighs and is partially open at the chest. The man's head is turned downwards, looking at his legs or feet. There is an ornate chair to the right of the man against a dark, subtly gradient background.

artworks.title: Ma foi! c'est comme on dit...
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a full-body view. He is standing in a slightly hunched position, looking into a small mirror he holds. He has prominent facial features, including a large nose. The man's hair is short and combed back. He is wearing a long robe with an intricate floral pattern and dark trim. The robe is slightly open, revealing a part of his chest. In his other hand, he holds a toothbrush. Behind him is a chair with a piece of cloth draped over the back. The background is lightly shaded, indicating an indoor setting with minimal detail.

artworks.title: Le Jour n'est pas plus pur...
artworks.description: The image shows two people standing facing each other. The person on the left has crossed arms and a serious expression with a beard, curly hair, and a garland. They wear a tunic under a dark vest. The person on the right gestures towards their chest with a concerned expression, featuring an elongated nose, curly hair adorned with a garland, and wearing a draped garment with a decorative emblem and a quiver with arrows. The background is a simple, lightly sketched texture with no specific details. Text above the characters includes titles and annotations.

artworks.title: Oui je viens, dans son temple...
artworks.description: The image portrays the upper bodies of two individuals. The person on the left wears a classical-style helmet with armor detailing and looks to the right. The person on the right appears elderly with long white hair, a beard, and mustache. They are draped in a simple garment and raising one hand expressively, with the other hand lowered at their side. The background is a textured shading typical of a drawn illustration, with inscriptions above and below the figures.

artworks.title: Oh!... absolument comme si on y était; la grande...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures using a telescope from a window. The image shows two individuals leaning out of a window, with one person looking through a long telescope while the other appears to peer over their shoulder. The setting suggests an urban environment, as architectural features are visible in the distance. The scene is depicted in a monochromatic style using pen and ink, emphasizing the contrast between shadows and highlights. The composition and style of the artwork suggest a moment of curiosity or voyeurism. There is text located below the image.
